speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, how long have you had the fever, wrist pain, and skin lesions, and can you describe what the rash looks like?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR), and C-Reactive Protein (CRP). Please also provide details on the specific appearance and distribution of the skin lesions and any joint swelling.
